title: Payment provider called synchronously in the request path with no timeout
context: Checkout is the primary revenue path; roughly 30 RPS peak; no circuit breaker present
impact: Provider latency propagates directly to users. A provider stall exhausts the web worker pool and takes down all endpoints, not just checkout.
remedy: Set an explicit client timeout (2 s connect, 5 s read) and isolate the call behind a bulkhead so provider degradation cannot consume the whole pool
trigger: Revisit for asynchronous processing when checkout p95 exceeds 800 ms or provider error rate exceeds 1% over 1 hour
